extraction_notes: Figure 8 values not printed in text were read approximately from the plotted points and are marked with qualifier '~'. Figure 7a is an Arrhenius plot with ln(rate) on the y-axis; non-text values were not extracted because the schema records rate and no back-calculation was performed. Figure 7b time-on-stream plot was small/dense, so individual stability points were not extracted; the printed steady rates at 400 °C were extracted from the text. Supporting-information Tables S1–S4 and Figures S9–S11 were referenced in the paper but not supplied in the input.
